verified_rules.rule: Referral to Basin Directorate for listed water take/use, wastewater discharges, priority/hazardous substance water contact; director response within 7 days after receipt; when incomplete data Basin Directorate specifies what and at which stage should be supplied.
verified_rules.condition: Facts of water-related triggers established; no universal basin referral

verified_rules.rule: At first notice stage deficiencies: give investor at least 7 days for correction; missing response can trigger discontinuation under al.5; correction period excluded from 14-day notice period in al.1.
verified_rules.condition: Do not apply to later assessment-request deficiency without separate art.6 verification

verified_rules.rule: For request for EIA screening missing/inaccurate documentation: investor gets at least 7 days; failure can terminate review of request, time excluded from art.93 al.6 ZOOS decision deadline.
Termination when competent authority confirms legal inadmissibility; separate 12-month inactivity criteria followed by reminder letter and up-to-14-day response period.
verified_rules.condition: 12 months plus reminder does not cover all termination causes; cannot terminate automatically from mere missing data

verified_rules.rule: If administrative individual act belongs to different agency, case-file is forwarded immediately, with notice; submission in deadline to incompetent agency counts as timely.
verified_rules.condition: Only general individual administrative act proceeding; first inspect special statutory rules

verified_rules.rule: Proposals and signals to wrong authority forwarded no later than 7 days except if issue already sent; originator notified.
verified_rules.condition: Not general deadline for all incoming case files

verified_rules.rule: Proposal resolved within 2 months; communicated within 7 days; exceptional further inquiry higher authority may prolong resolution up to 6 months; decision not appealed.
verified_rules.condition: Proposal qualifies under APK art.107 rather than procedural objection or application

verified_rules.rule: Signal resolved within 2 months; higher authority may extend by no more than 1 month for especially important reasons and notify author.
verified_rules.condition: Special law may provide other applicable procedure
